name: familiar
title: Familiar
description: a small first-person open-world Halloween game on Strata: you are Wren, twelve, out on Halloween night in a New England hill town; trick-or-treat, turn into a cat, light lanterns, brew Nana's cider and bring her old cat's spirit home by midnight.
cheats: Do not use `--autopilot`, `--tour` or `--fresh` unless your goal says so.

goals.goal: Play the opening of the night as a brand-new player who has never seen the game: work out what to do from the screen, choose a costume, trick-or-treat, and follow whatever the game points you to next; note every moment of confusion.
